correctness.rationale: Complete enumerated 772 augmented faces, double membership verification on 4096 masks, exact signed boundary-square checks, 378 pair matching with full 2940-incidence acyclicity check, and explicit integral six-by-ten Morse boundary. Its rank is exactly three with a +1 minor, so three primitive attachments cancel homotopically; six 3-cells plus ten 4-cells reduce to three 3-spheres and seven 4-spheres. Independent mod-two ranks concur. Finite claim only; proof does not extrapolate.

value.rationale: The octahedral graph K_2,2,2 is a canonical 4-regular nonbipartite complete tripartite graph. Its first natural matching relaxation M_2 is not an arbitrary slice: it tests topology beyond the classic degree-one matching complex in a simple symmetric graph. The complete unexpected mixed-dimensional S3/S4 integral homotopy type, despite facets through dimension five, gives a mathematically motivated finite benchmark. Neither code correctness nor search novelty alone is used as the value argument.
